title: Praanamgaa Preminchina – Satish Kumar Telugu Christian Lyrics

credits.Vocals: Dr P Satish Kumar, Anup Rubens & Bro. Sunil

intro: Praanamgaa Preminchina Devudu is the latest Christmas Telugu song written by pastor, singer, song-writer, preacher, evangelist, Dr P Satish Kumar, tuned by Bro. Sunil, sung by Dr P Satish Kumar, Anup Rubens & Bro. Sunil and music composed by Anup Rubens. This song video was released on December 04, 2022 through Dr Satish Kumar Youtube Channel.
